summaries.zh-Hans: 显示系统盘已用百分比的托盘小组件，5 秒一刷，同内置系统盘件。
summaries.en: Tray widget showing system disk usage percentage, refreshed every 5 seconds.

descriptions.zh-Hans:
指标风格的系统盘占用小组件：

- 数据源用 `df -k /` 取根分区已用百分比（零依赖）
- 磁盘变化慢，可见时 5 秒一刷即可，收起自动停表
- 阈值配色与内置件一致（≥75% 变黄、≥90% 变红）

源码与内置系统盘件同款，把脚本里的挂载点换掉即可监控其它磁盘。
descriptions.en:
Metric-style system disk usage widget:

- Data source reads the root partition usage percentage via `df -k /` (zero dependencies)
- Disks change slowly, so it refreshes every 5 seconds while visible and pauses when hidden
- Same threshold colors as the built-in widget (yellow at 75%, red at 90%)

Same source as the built-in disk widget; change the mount point in the script to watch another disk.
